metadata.purpose: Select leading and/or latest trailing source values using one active scheduled duration.

conditions: Source values only are forwarded; duration payloads are ignored.
Busy values do not extend a duration. A trailing output starts another duration while the source is live.
Source completion waits only when trailing output is enabled, a value is pending and a duration is active.
With both flags false, no next notification is emitted.

scope.parameters: leading=false, trailing=false. Positive integer duration 1..1000 with a deferred FIFO virtual scheduler.
scope.callbacks: No user callback. A scheduled duration is a source of timer.fire inputs.
scope.time: All event times are supplied nonnegative safe integers. Equal-time order is input order. timer.fire must name the current generation and occur at or after its deadline; lateness does not backdate output. No progress occurs merely because a deadline exists.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Zero/negative/fractional durations, synchronous queueScheduler, custom scheduler exceptions and platform timing precision.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: No connection during construction. The first result subscription applies the profile-specific acquisition rule.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay. Each result subscription owns its memory and resource generations; supplied producers may themselves be shared.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Current scheduled duration action executes at supplied now.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Open.
See the typed state and named transitions for Throttled.
Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

rules.guard: first result connection; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: subscribe source; create no duration yet
rules.nextState: Open with empty pending memory and next duration generation zero.
rules.explanation: The first value, not subscription itself, starts throttling.

rules.guard: no active duration; leading=false; valid nondecreasing supplied time
rules.nextState: Duration generation advances; this value is pending for a possible trailing output.
rules.explanation: A leading emission precedes duration selection/acquisition. With leading=false the same source value still starts a duration.

rules.guard: a duration is active; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: replace pending value without restarting duration or emitting
rules.nextState: Same duration generation/deadline; pending presence=true with newest payload.
rules.explanation: Busy source values update latest memory. They do not call the selector or postpone the current timer.

rules.guard: current duration ends; trailing=false; valid nondecreasing supplied time
rules.nextState: Open with no active duration; preserve any un-emitted internal memory until replaced.
rules.explanation: No trailing emission means no automatic new duration. A later source value starts the next duration.

rules.guard: source completes with no active duration; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: complete result without flushing retained value
rules.nextState: Closed complete; all pending memory discarded.
rules.explanation: There is no active duration to justify waiting, even if an empty duration previously left internal pending memory.

rules.nextState: Closed complete; no pending value is emitted.
rules.explanation: A lone leading value does not require waiting for its duration to expire.

rules.guard: source fails; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release source and any active duration without flushing
rules.explanation: Failure is never delayed until a duration ends.

rules.guard: source fails; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release source and any active duration without flushing
rules.explanation: Failure is never delayed until a duration ends.

rules.guard: consumer cancels this execution; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release only still-owned source/duration resources; emit nothing
rules.explanation: Cancellation during completion-waiting releases only the duration; the source has already ended.
